experiment: Fixed adaptive OEPLB vs same-session baseline (2 constructions)

construction_A.dataset: crossdomain_freq6_O10.jsonl (6 segments book<->prover, 4438tok, 4200 req, conc=32, O=10)

fixes: auto dead_zone_ratio from EP power law (r_k=1+0.00408*EP^1.52)
finding: Adaptive gives consistent 8-9% across both constructions without per-workload alpha tuning. On construction B it even beats all fixed alpha values.
